caption: The drawing depicts a textile sample with a rectangular shape, shown on a plain off-white background. The textile features alternating vertical stripes in red, green, and white colors. The red and green stripes are decorated with diamond and small geometric patterns in white, while other sections are adorned with floral and leaf motifs. Birds are visible within the floral patterns, particularly in the left and lower sections of the textile. On the right side, there is a corner of the textile folded over, revealing a reverse side that displays more stylized floral and geometric designs. At the bottom of the page, the text reads "WESTCHESTER COUNTY," "SCALE 1"=1 FOOT," and "EDMOND W. BROWN" in small, uppercase letters. The entire textile is bordered by thin green and red lines. The drawing has some faint brown staining and discoloration on the background paper, especially near the top edge.
title: White House Bed Cover
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
